options.concept: An obsolete breathing machine exhales into an empty transparent respiratory mask held in front of the woman, allowing condensation, connected tubing and her interrupted movement to carry the unease.
An automatic arm cuff keeps operating in an abandoned examination bay while the woman holds its visibly detached power plug, watching the machine rather than the viewer.
The woman withdraws from an optical examination chin rest while the machine aperture remains aimed at her eye, its lit measuring arm occupying the narrow escape gap.
A mobile circular scanner has stopped with its aperture between the woman and the doorway; she braces its parked frame while tracing its unused patient support with her gaze.
